about_the_game:
Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, purchase packs, and guide the evolution of species according to mission requirements.

Key Features:

  • Innovative Breeding System: Creatures choose who to reproduce with (even with enemy creatures). Try to make them choose who you want (inbreeding may occur).

  • Visual style: 2.5D isometric pixel art style with characters that have 8-way animations.

  • Diferents Creatures: More than 10 different types of creatures, with different stats and qualities.

  • All in Real-Time: The game has an isometric layout, with a tile-based system. But unlike other similar games, it's not turn-based. Everything happens at the same instant, in real time.

  • Dynamic environment in constant evolution: There will be events that alter the environment and the creatures.

  • Progression system: You'll earn resources upon completing each mission; use them to upgrade different systems. This way, you'll be able to complete the next mission with less difficulty and/or take on more complex missions.
